Frequently asked

Do I need an appointment?

Booking ahead is the best way to get the time you want, and it only takes about a minute with the Book now button. For same-day questions call 0917 890 4597.

What are your opening hours?

Both our Taguig and Cavite · Lancaster branches are open daily from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

Where are your branches?

Taguig: 251 Manuel L. Quezon St., Hagonoy, Taguig.
Cavite · Lancaster: Unit 14 Amaroo Bldg., Arnaldo Highway, Purok 3, Pasong Camachili 1, General Trias, Cavite.

Why do hair prices say “from”?

Hair services start from the price shown. The final price depends on your hair length and condition, and your stylist will confirm it before starting.

What is Organic Protein Straightbond?

A plant-based, vegan treatment for smooth, natural-looking straight hair. It is described as safe for kids and moms-to-be, gives about 70–90% straight results, and you can wash your hair the same day.
